data.body: **P2 — Stop emitting completion spans after ending their parents.** A fresh update arriving while the second `forceFlush()` awaits is still drained through `onOperationEnd`, although Invocation and terminal Workflow have already ended. In `InvocationOtelPlugin`, the resulting continuation starts at the current time, after its parent's end; the execution view likewise overruns Workflow when the completion boundary is later. This breaks containment even without clock skew. Establish a completion cutoff and drain accepted updates before ending parents, then make the final pass provider-only and handle later notifications through recovery. Apply the ordering to both views and add a regression that blocks the second flush; the added containment test blocks only the first.
